![Trekv4 in four themes](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nbetcher/pebbleface-trekv4/v6.0.0/docs/images/faces.png)

**Trekv4 6.0 is a ground-up rebuild.** The LCARS frame is now drawn live by the watch
instead of shipped as pictures, so every piece can take any color, every rectangular
Pebble gets a layout tuned to its screen, and Settings can show you exactly what
your watch will look like before you save.

### Highlights
- **Drawn in code.** 13 vector frame pieces with smooth, anti-aliased edges. No theme images.
- **Any piece, any color.** Keep one of 12 classic themes, or pick a color for every piece of the frame, the text, the background, the Bluetooth symbol and the battery bars.
- **Live, pinned preview in Settings.** On Pebble Time 2 the preview runs the watchface's own drawing code, translated to JavaScript, so it matches the watch pixel for pixel. Tap any element to recolor it.
- **Every rectangular Pebble**, now including Pebble Time 2 and Pebble 2 Duo.
- **Red Alert.** Nine Star Trek-themed disconnect vibrations, optional repeats, and an LCARS popup you shake away.
- **Weather with no account.** Now powered by Open-Meteo. Location stays off until you turn it on.
- **Quiet Time indicator is back**, plus heart rate on supported watches.

### Also
- Settings reorganized into clear sections that show only what your watch supports.
- Messages to the watch are queued and retried, so saved settings and weather aren't lost.
- A full code audit fixed a long list of bugs, and 129 automated tests now guard the result.
- Your existing settings and colors carry over automatically.

### Good to know
- **Round watches are no longer supported.** Pebble Time Round owners should stay on 5.2.
- Original Pebble and Pebble Steel have very little free memory. If something looks off on one, please [open an issue](https://github.com/nbetcher/pebbleface-trekv4/issues).
